question: Which accent goes into theme.css? Same library card and table in each. A is the blue from round-001 c (cards), B the muted indigo from round-002 b (tables), C the stock neutral control. The accent colors the in-progress, in-review and active dots, the High pill and the progress bars. Your pick becomes the app accent in theme.css.

variants.label: Blue accent
variants.changes: --primary, --primary-foreground and --ring from round-001 c (hue 262). --destructive and --muted-foreground stay stock. round-001 c's --chart-* are left out: the library does not read them.

variants.label: Muted indigo
variants.changes: --primary and --primary-foreground from round-002 b (hue 265, low chroma). --ring added in the same hue so focus matches. --destructive and --muted-foreground stay stock.

variants.label: Neutral (stock)
variants.changes: No overrides. Stock shadcn neutral: near-black accent in light, near-white in dark. The control.
